entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Non grand slams. Jozy pa renmen yo depi li te pèdi D'Antone?" t="No grand slams. Jozy don't like them since he lost to D'Antone." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Non grand slams. Jozy pa renmen yo depi li te pèdi D'Antone?" t="Fără grand slam-uri. Lui Jozy nu-i plac de când a pierdut cu D'Antone." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="D'Antone? Ti kras kaka D'Antone sa?" t="D'Antone? The little shit, that D'Antone?" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="D'Antone? Ti kras kaka D'Antone sa?" t="D'Antone? Căcatul ăla mic, D'Antone ăla?" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Oh, Mèd?" t="Oh, fuck." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Oh, Mèd?" t="Oh, futu-i." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Ki moun ki di sa? Ki moun ki di D'Antone?" t="Who said that? Who said D'Antone?" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Ki moun ki di sa? Ki moun ki di D'Antone?" t="Cine a zis asta? Cine a zis D'Antone?" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Ou tèlman enterese nan D'Antone, ale nan lari li! Se kote li jwe?" t="You so interested in D'Antone, go hang out on his street! That's where he plays!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Ou tèlman enterese nan D'Antone, ale nan lari li! Se kote li jwe?" t="Ești atât de interesat de D'Antone, du-te pe strada lui! Acolo joacă!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Mwen jwe isit la! Konprann?! Mwenmem, pa ti kaka sa?" t="I play here! Understand?! Me, not that little shit!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Mwen jwe isit la! Konprann?! Mwenmem, pa ti kaka sa?" t="Eu joc aici! Înțelegi?! Eu, nu căcatul ăla mic!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Ti moun gen tout cyber-dinkses nan sèvo li! Li pa jis?" t="Kid has all those cyber-dinkses in his brain! It's not fair!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Ti moun gen tout cyber-dinkses nan sèvo li! Li pa jis?" t="Copilul are toate alea cyber-dinkses în creier! Nu e corect!" b="" a=""/>
